title: Marlowe Rewards Membership Length: Restocking Fee Caps on Store Credit Recoveries
content:
When Gift Cards & Store Credit recovers instant Return Store Credit after a return's inspection, the restocking fee the recovery includes (the recovery's restocking part) is capped by the length of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership on the recovery date.

## Schedule

| Length of the Marlowe Rewards membership on the recovery date | Restocking part of the recovery |
|---|---|
| Enrolled at least 60 whole months earlier | The booked restocking fee, capped at 15.00 |
| Enrolled at least 24 but fewer than 60 whole months earlier | The booked restocking fee, capped at 25.00 |
| Enrolled fewer than 24 whole months earlier, or no Marlowe Rewards membership | The booked restocking fee, uncapped |

Length is counted in whole months from the enrolment date shown on the Marlowe Rewards membership to the recovery date; a month is complete only once the recovery date reaches the same day of the month as the enrolment date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical members, restocking fee booked at 30.00)

| Enrolled | Recovery date | Whole months | Restocking part |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2021 | 14 March 2026 | 59 | 25.00 |
| 15 March 2021 | 15 March 2026 | 60 | 15.00 |
| 10 June 2024 | 9 June 2026 | 23 | 30.00 |
| 10 June 2024 | 10 June 2026 | 24 | 25.00 |
| Not a member | any | none | 30.00 |

A booked fee already below the cap is not raised: with 12.00 booked, a member of 60 whole months has a restocking part of 12.00, since the cap is a ceiling and not a fixed charge.
